**Price movement**
KO last closed at 69.41. The forecast starts at 69.41 and ends at 69.41 after 30 trading days, so it projects no net change over the period.

**Model quality**
Over a 30-day backtest, the model's mean absolute error (MAE) was 1.2088, against 1.105 for the naive baseline. Its mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) was 1.73%. The model does not beat the naive baseline.

**Interpretation**
The flat forecast implies no expected drift, not that the price will stay fixed. Day-to-day moves of the size seen in the backtest remain likely. Because the model did not outperform a simple carry-forward of the last price, it adds little predictive value here and should not drive decisions on its own.

Educational analysis — not investment advice.
